response.justification: The candidate lacks the mandatory C++ experience on Windows platforms (15+ years in C/C++ but primarily in D, Node.js, TypeScript, and Java). While they have strong software development experience and domain exposure to investment practices (RIDE Capital), their profile does not align with the core technical stack or domain expertise required for this role.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong problem-solving and software craftsmanship skills (TDD, CI/CD)
Demonstrated experience in investment and capital markets domain (RIDE Capital)
concerns: No significant hands-on C++ development on Windows in the last 10+ years
Lacks required SQL Server/Oracle expertise (only mentions generic SQL)
Limited exposure to fixed income or capital markets systems
